candidate_diagnostics.interpretation: Separate intrusive Python diagnostic, including candidate installation and continuous runs. Exceptions may be intentionally handled; False returns may be normal predicates. These are source locations for investigation, not proof of failure or causal attribution. Only candidate installer files on the worker's current Python thread are traced; native code, other threads and imported helper files are outside this observation.
